paper.abstract_en: Inspired by black hole thermodynamics and other results suggesting that general relativity has some intrinsic connection with thermodynamics, this work aims to establish a quasi-local thermodynamic formalism in general spacetimes. With this purpose, we generalize the Bondi-Sachs formalism to past light cones associated with an arbitrary worldline. From this generalization, we demonstrate the emission of Hawking radiation in a quasi-local context through a few examples, suggesting that it may occur under mild conditions. In addition, we argue that an "irreversible inequality" is satisfied in typical gravitational systems, indicating that an analogue of the second law may be established. Together with a definition of internal energy derived from the Landau-Lifshitz pseudotensor, these results are used to construct a postulational framework that generalizes classical thermodynamics in order to include the dynamics of spacetime. As a consequence, it is possible to define the rest-mass density from thermodynamic variables, decoupling it from the dynamics of constituent numbers.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文将 Bondi-Sachs 形式推广至与任意世界线相关的过去光锥，构建准局域热力学框架，涉及霍金辐射、不可逆不等式与第二定律类比，并尝试用 Landau-Lifshitz 赝张量定义内能，理论深度与新颖性较高，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 光锥热力学：准局域形式体系
decision.abstract_zh: 受黑洞热力学以及其他暗示广义相对论与热力学存在某种内在联系的结果的启发，本工作旨在一般时空中建立一种准局域热力学形式体系。为此，我们将 Bondi-Sachs 形式体系推广到与任意世界线相关的过去光锥。基于这一推广，我们通过若干例子证明了在准局域背景下霍金辐射的发射，这暗示它可能在较温和的条件下发生。此外，我们论证在典型引力系统中满足一个“不可逆不等式”，这表明可以建立第二定律的某种类比。结合由 Landau-Lifshitz 赝张量导出的内能定义，这些结果被用来构建一个公理化框架，以将经典热力学推广至包含时空动力学。作为一个推论，可以从热力学变量定义静止质量密度，使其与组分数的动力学解耦。
